intro: The Reserve at Hudson Bend is a quiet cul de sac enclave of about 40 homes on lots of 1.5 to 2 acres. CleanzATX cleans windows here with pure water, and it is not the Spicewood Reserve, so we plan accordingly.

sections.h2: What Reserve at Hudson Bend homes are like
paragraphs: About 40 homes were built here in 2003 and 2004, on lots of 1.5 to 2 acres. Homes run 3,500 to 5,000 sq ft, with prices from $1.2M to $2.5M. The Reserve at Hudson Bend HOA manages the enclave. It is not gated, and the streets run through a cul de sac layout that keeps through traffic out.
Take care with the name. There is also a Reserve in Spicewood, and this one is the Hudson Bend neighborhood near Lake Travis. We put the right address on the route and avoid mix ups.

sections.h2: What Reserve at Hudson Bend windows deal with
paragraphs: Homes from the early 2000s have had time to collect hard water history. Years of sprinklers on acre sized lawns leave mineral rings on lower panes, and some of it may already have started to etch. We remove spots at $10 per pane and tell you first if the glass has damage that will not come out.

Mature landscaping now shades a lot of these houses. Live oaks and cedars drop pollen and leaf litter on screens and in tracks. The stucco and stone around the windows also hold green growth and dust, so a house soft wash ties in naturally with a window visit.

sections.h2: How we work Reserve at Hudson Bend
paragraphs: Since there is no gate, the work is easy to book. HOA rules are about the community, not routine window cleaning, but check your documents if you are unsure. We bring our own water in the truck and use water fed poles to reach up to three stories from the ground. Lots are large, so we plan a route around the whole house, including any pool area. Patios and pool decks, if you want them, are cleaned by hand.
A 4,000 sq ft home comes to about $400 for exterior windows at $0.10 per sq ft. Plan on roughly three to four hours on site for the outside of a house that size.

faq.q: Is this the same as The Reserve in Spicewood?
faq.a: No. Ours is The Reserve at Hudson Bend, near Lake Travis in 78734. When you text us, mention the neighborhood by name, and we will confirm the location before booking.

faq.q: Does the HOA allow window cleaning vendors?
faq.a: Routine window cleaning is normally fine, but each HOA sets its own rules. Check your association documents or ask your manager if you want to be sure. We are happy to provide insurance details when asked.

faq.q: How long does a 4,000 sq ft house take?
faq.a: Exterior takes about 45 to 60 minutes per 1,000 sq ft, so roughly three to four hours. Interior takes about 30 minutes per 1,000 sq ft, or two hours more if you want inside and out.

faq.q: Can you remove the white rings from my sprinklers?
faq.a: Usually, yes. Taking off hard water spots is $10 per pane. Rings that have sat for many years may have etched the glass slightly, and we will say so before we start.

faq.q: Do you also clean the roof?
faq.a: Yes. Roof soft wash starts at $0.25 per sq ft with a $400 minimum. We use a 12V soft wash system at low pressure, which is the safe way to treat a roof.
